title: Don't be so sure / He may have been busy ...
subtitle: 别那么肯定 / 他可能一直很忙……

lead.question: 「我们可能出国，也可能哪儿都去不成」——谈计划又没把握时，你会用 may 把这种「不确定」说出来吗？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。每年度假前都会上演同一幕：想去哪儿？怎么去？谁照看狗、房子和花园？英语里表达「可能去、也许便宜」用 may + 动词原形：We may go abroad. It may be cheaper. 表达对过去的事没把握用 may have (been)：He may have been busy. 注意 may 的否定是 may not（可能不），而「拿不定主意」是 can't make up our minds。先想想你自己的度假计划会不会也泡汤，再听 Gary 怎么年年「哪儿也去不成」。
goals: 能用 may + 动词原形表示现在或将来的可能性（We may go abroad.）
能用 may have (been) 表示过去的可能性（He may have been busy.）
掌握 make up one's mind（打定主意）、look after（照料）等短语
会用 by sea / by air 回答选择疑问句
lead.summary: 第 131 课 Roy 问 Gary 今年去哪儿度假。Gary 说也许出国、妻子想去埃及，但拿不定主意；也许乘船去——可能便宜些，但时间长。Roy 相信他们一定会玩得开心，Gary 却说别那么肯定：妻子总是担心狗、房子、花园没人照看，每年最后都是呆在家里照看一切！第 132 课集中操练 may be（现在可能）与 may have been（过去可能）。
lead.tips: ① may/might 都表「可能」，might 的可能性更小；② may + 动词原形表现在/将来：The bread may be fresh. 否定 may not；③ 对过去推测用 may have (done)：He was late. He may have been busy.；④ make up one's mind 下决心，复数 minds（We can't make up our minds.）；⑤ by sea 乘船 / by air 乘飞机，回答选择疑问句别用 Yes/No，要选其一；⑥ look after = take care of 照料；in the end 最后，终于。

questions.q: What's the problem about deciding on a holiday?
questions.zh: 决定如何度假有什么为难的地方？
questions.a: Gary's wife always worries too much — who will look after the dog, the house and the garden — so in the end they stay at home and look after everything.
questions.aZh: 加里的妻子总是担心这担心那：谁照看狗、房子和花园？所以最后他们只能呆在家里照看一切。
questions.hint: 听 Don't be so sure. 之后的三个 Who's going to look after ...?

questions.q: Where does Gary's wife want to go?
questions.a: She wants to go to Egypt.
questions.hint: Gary 的第一段话里有个国名。

questions.q: Will they travel by sea or by air?
questions.zh: 他们打算乘船去还是乘飞机去？
questions.hint: Gary 对交通方式也没把握，用了 may。

questions.q: What does Gary say about travelling by sea?
questions.zh: 关于乘船旅行，加里说了什么？
questions.a: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
questions.aZh: 乘船可能便宜些，但花的时间长。
questions.hint: It's cheaper, isn't it? 之后 Gary 的回答。

questions.q: What is the difference between 'may' and 'might'?
questions.zh: may 和 might 在表示「可能」时有什么区别？
questions.a: Both mean possibility. Usually either is possible, but 'might' suggests a smaller chance; and in unreal (subjunctive) situations only 'might' can be used.
questions.aZh: 两者都表「可能」。通常可以互换，但 might 表示的可能性比 may 小；虚拟的情况只能用 might。

questions.q: I'm not sure. They may be Australian. / I'm not sure. She may have been a doctor.
questions.zh: 第 132 课操练：用 I'm not sure + may be / may have been 表达不肯定的猜测。
questions.a: I'm not sure. He may be the boss.
questions.aZh: 我说不准。他可能是老板。
questions.hint: 对现在用 may be，对过去用 may have been。

lines.speaker: ROY
lines.en: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
lines.zh: 加里，今年你们打算去哪里度假？

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.en: We may go abroad. I'm not sure. My wife wants to go to Egypt. I'd like to go there, too. We can't make up our minds.
lines.zh: 我们可能到国外去，但我不敢肯定。我妻子想到埃及去，我也想去那儿。我们还拿不定主意。
lines.note: may 表可能性；make up one's minds 打定主意

lines.speaker: ROY
lines.en: Will you travel by sea or by air?
lines.zh: 你们乘船去，还是乘飞机去？

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.en: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
lines.zh: 可能是便宜些，但花的时间长。
lines.note: take a long time 花很长时间

lines.speaker: ROY
lines.en: I'm sure you will enjoy yourselves.
lines.zh: 我肯定你们一定会玩得很痛快。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.en: Don't be so sure. We may not go anywhere. My wife always worries too much. Who's going to look after the dog? Who's going to look after the house? Who's going to look after the garden? We have this problem every year. In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
lines.zh: 别那么肯定。我们可能哪里也去不成。我妻子总是担心这担心那：谁来照看狗啦，谁来看管房子啦，谁来照料花园啦？我们每年都碰到这类问题。到头来，我们总是呆在家里照看一切！
lines.note: Don't be so sure. 否定祈使句；look after 照料

drill.q: I'm not sure. They/She/He may be ___. / I'm not sure. They/She/He may have been ___.
drill.zh: 我说不准。他们/她/他可能是……。/ 我说不准。他们/她/他当时可能是……。（用 may be 表现在、may have been 表过去）
answers: I'm not sure. They may be Australian.
I'm not sure. She may have been a doctor.

grammar.title: may / might 表示可能性
grammar.definition: may 或 might 都表示「可能」「也许」。通常两者可以通用，不过 might 表示的可能性比 may 小；虚拟的情况只能用 might。否定式 may not 表「可能不」。
grammar.usage: 谈计划没把握时最常用：We may go abroad. We may not go anywhere.

examples.en: The bread may be fresh.
examples.zh: 面包可能是新鲜的。

examples.en: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
examples.zh: 可能是便宜些，但花的时间长。

grammar.title: may have (done) —— 对过去的可能性的推测
grammar.definition: may 也可表示过去的可能性，过去式结构为 may have (done)；may have been doing 表示对过去正进行的动作的猜测。
grammar.usage: He was late. He may have been busy.（他迟到了，可能一直很忙。）

examples.en: He was late. He may have been busy.
examples.zh: 他迟到了。他可能一直很忙。

examples.en: They may have been in the garden.
examples.zh: 他们那时可能一直在花园里。

grammar.title: 选择疑问句
grammar.structure: 一般疑问句 + or + 另一选项?
grammar.definition: 用 or 提供两个（或以上）选项供对方选择，语调前升后降；回答时不用 Yes/No，直接选其中一项。
grammar.usage: Will you travel by sea or by air? — We may travel by sea.
